Evidence / output: Discover: time the existing manual process and identify request categories and exception cases.
Scope: select one source, one draft output and one human approval route; document minimum permissions.
Prepare: create fictional requests, required field schema, stable identifiers and expected test outcomes.
Build: configure validation, drafting, exact-action review, deduplication, bounded retries and error notifications.
Evaluate: test approvals, denials, duplicate events, missing fields, injection, revoked access, outage and cost stops.
Release: connect a limited owner-approved real input source without removing approval controls.
Operate: observe seven days, compare time and failures with manual work and correct issues.
Hand over: document connector ownership, retention, manual recovery, budget and shutdown.
